en.intro: Modern engineering isn't about typing boilerplate faster—it's about knowing what to build, why a design holds under pressure, and where it breaks.

pillars.title: Native Over Wrappers
pillars.desc: Heavy AI frameworks hide critical execution paths behind fragile abstractions. I build core orchestration loops natively to retain full visibility over state, latency, and token economics.

pillars.title: Deterministic Governance
pillars.desc: LLMs are probabilistic; production systems cannot be. I isolate probabilistic reasoning from deterministic runtime validation, atomic DB leasing, and strict security boundaries.

pillars.title: Audit-Driven Execution
pillars.desc: Every system I ship undergoes manual line-by-line code auditing, architectural stress-testing, and empirical validation for performance bottlenecks and security gaps.

id.intro: Rekayasa perangkat lunak modern bukan soal siapa paling cepat mengetik boilerplate—melainkan memahami apa yang harus dibangun, mengapa desainnya kuat saat ditekan, dan di mana titik lemahnya.

pillars.title: Native di Atas Wrapper
pillars.desc: Framework AI yang berat sering menyembunyikan alur eksekusi di balik abstraksi rapuh. Saya membangun loop orkestrasi secara native demi kendali penuh atas state, latensi, dan efisiensi token.

pillars.title: Tata Kelola Deterministik
pillars.desc: LLM bersifat probabilistik, sedangkan sistem produksi tidak boleh menebak-nebak. Saya memisahkan penalaran model dari validasi runtime deterministik, leasing DB atomik, dan batas keamanan ketat.

pillars.title: Eksekusi Berbasis Audit
pillars.desc: Setiap sistem melewati audit kode manual baris demi baris, pengujian tekanan arsitektur, serta validasi empiris terhadap hambatan performa dan celah keamanan.
